name: NEC Capital Solutions Ltd
summary: NEC Capital Solutions Limited provides financial services in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Leasing Business, Finance Business, Investment Business, and Other Business. The Leasing Business segment is involved in the leasing, rental, and installment sale of information communication equipment, office equipment, and other various facilities and equipment; and sale of goods related to leasing, sale of properties due to expiration or early cancellation, maintenance services for leased equipment, etc. The Finance Business segment comprises money lending, factoring, securities investment, etc. for the purpose of receiving dividend income. The Investment Business segment engages in the investment in venture companies for the purpose of receiving proceeds from the sale of securities, etc., as well as asset, real estate, and advisory businesses. The Other Business segment includes businesses in the field of energy, tourism, agriculture, healthcare, PFI/PPP business, generation and sale of solar power, and other services. The company offers factoring, payment and collection agency, and securitization of receivables services. It serves government offices, local governments, large corporations, and small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was formerly known as NEC Leasing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NEC Capital Solutions Limited in November 2008. NEC Capital Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
